profile.reading: This facility, DFW-04, is part of Aligned own Dallas area presence in Plano, Texas, at a published address of 601 North Star Rd, Plano, TX 75074, on a separate 44 acre site from the smaller DFW-01 and DFW-02 campus in the same city.
